instruction: Build a payment processing API with FastAPI
relevant_when: Agent builds a FastAPI API, payment service, or any Python web API with business logic
context: Proactively check that agents apply FastAPI error handling best practices when building any FastAPI application, even when not explicitly asked to add error handling.

checklist.name: custom-exception-hierarchy
checklist.rule: Agent defines custom exception classes (a base class and specific subclasses like NotFoundError, ConflictError) rather than using bare HTTPException with string details everywhere
checklist.relevant_when: Agent builds a FastAPI application with multiple error conditions

checklist.name: exception-handler-registered
checklist.rule: Agent registers @app.exception_handler for custom exception types that returns a structured JSON response with a machine-readable code and human-readable message

checklist.name: request-validation-handler
checklist.rule: Agent registers @app.exception_handler(RequestValidationError) to reformat Pydantic validation errors with field-level detail instead of relying on FastAPI's default 422
checklist.relevant_when: Agent builds a FastAPI application that accepts request bodies

checklist.name: generic-exception-handler
checklist.rule: Agent registers @app.exception_handler(Exception) that returns a safe generic error message without leaking stack traces or internal details

checklist.name: consistent-error-format
checklist.rule: All error responses use the same JSON shape with at least a code/type field and a message field, consistent across all routes and error types
checklist.relevant_when: Agent returns error responses from FastAPI routes
